pages.title: About Us
pages.heading: Fueling strength Passion, And Ambition
evidence: It all began with a dream of being India's leading homegrown denim brand.
Welcome to the Young at Heart Fashion Revolution!
Every pair of our jeans is infused with a playful spirit that embraces adventure, boldness, and endless possibilities.
Since 2014, Spykar has been a part of the Bagri family-promoted Metdist Group.
Spykar is present across 2250 points of sales, including 300+ exclusive stores, large format retail and major ecommerce platforms.
The page describes precision, craftsmanship, durability and reducing environmental impact as brand commitments.

pages.title: Spykar Spring Summer 2026 Collection – Roots of Now
evidence: Roots of Now is designed for a generation that values both legacy and hustle.
The line celebrates individualism, culture and modern fashion.
India's textures, landscapes and cultural subtleties are combined with international fashion aesthetics.
The collection emphasizes breathable materials, relaxed silhouettes, movement, comfort and self-expression.
